---
permalink: /llms.txt
sitemap: false
---
<%
  # The internal-markdown-links plugin rewrites any literal "](" in the source, hence the split string
  entry = ->(resource, suffix = "") { "- [#{resource.data.title}]" + "(#{absolute_url resource.relative_url})#{suffix}" }
  help = site.collections.help.resources.sort_by(&:relative_url)
  guides = site.collections.guides.resources.reject { |guide| guide.data.skip_listing }
  specifications = site.collections.specifications.resources.sort_by(&:relative_url)
  updates = site.collections["product-updates"].resources.sort_by(&:date).reverse
%>
# Bump.sh documentation

> <%= site.metadata.description.strip %>

Bump.sh publishes API documentation from OpenAPI and AsyncAPI documents, and hosts MCP servers built from Flower or Arazzo workflow documents. Related resources: the Bump.sh API references at https://developers.bump.sh/ (MCP server at https://developers.bump.sh/mcp), the CLI at https://github.com/bump-sh/cli and the product at https://bump.sh/.

## Help center
<%= help.map { |page| entry.call(page) }.join("\n") %>

## Guides
<%= guides.map { |guide| entry.call(guide, guide.data.excerpt.present? ? ": #{guide.data.excerpt}" : "") }.join("\n") %>

## Specifications
<%= specifications.map { |page| entry.call(page) }.join("\n") %>

## Product updates
<%= updates.map { |update| entry.call(update, " (#{update.date.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")})") }.join("\n") %>
